ModMetaData.name: Visual Progression: Age Picker
ModMetaData.author: Groovy
ModMetaData.description:
Pick what your items, buildings and furniture look like and what they're called in each tech age, using the art of any mod in your mod list. Things made in that age get your pick and keep it. Pick in the mod settings. Changes apply after a restart.
Built on Visual Progression Framework. Something also has to raise your colony's tech level, such as Vanilla Factions Expanded - Tribals.
Preview and screenshot art: Medieval Overhaul, Vanilla Cooking Expanded and RimWorld.
